content: Amenɣi n ayt n Israil ak-d teqbič n Binyamin
Xenni ffɣen marra ayt n Israil, uca tmun tmesmunt am yijj n weryaz ɣar SIDI di Miṣfa, zi Dan ař Bi’r-Sebɛa uřa d tammurt n Jilɛad.
Imdebbaren n marra řgens, n marra tiqebbař n Israil, ssbedden ixef nsen di tmesmunt n AREBBI, arebɛa-mya-ařef n yeryazen x iḍaren, marra iryazen inni izemmaren x ssif.
Ayt n Binyamin sřin, aqa ayt n Israil geɛɛden ɣar Miṣfa. Ayt n Israil nnan: “Siwřem, mammec tzemmar ad temsar tuɛeffna-ya?”
Aryaz Alawi, aryaz n temɣart ittwanɣen, yarra-dd xasen: “Necc usiɣ-dd ak-d tayya inu zi Jibɛa tenni iǧan n Binyamin, ḥima ad ssenseɣ din.
Uca imezdaɣ n Jibɛa nnqeřben xafi, nnḍen ayi-dd di ǧiřet i taddart, nwan ad ayi nɣen u ɣeṣben tayya inu ařami temmut.
Xenni ksiɣ tayya inu, bḍiɣ tt d tiseqqar, ssekkeɣ ijj n wezyen zzayes ɣar marra jjwayeh n temmurt n tesɣart n Israil, minzi nitni ggin řefḍiḥet d tubbuheřya di Israil.
Xzar, kenniw marra d ayt n Israil. Arrem-dd kenniw x man aya s wawař d ccwar!”
Uca ibedd řgens imun am yijj n weryaz, inna: “Uřa d ijjen zzayneɣ war iggur ɣar tqiḍunt nnes u uřa d ijjen zzayneɣ war ittɛiqqib ɣar taddart nnes.
Ammu i ɣa negg xenni řexxu ak-d Jibɛa: ‘Ad xas neffeɣ ɛlaḥsab taqedduḥt!

Ad narecceḥ zi marra tiqebbař n Israil ɛecra n yeryazen zi mya u mya zeg wařef u ařef zi ɛecra-ařaf, ḥima ad awyen řeɛweč i řgens, ḥima, xmi i dd ɣa yasen ɣar Jibɛa tenni iǧan n Binyamin, ad zemmaren ad ggen akides ɛlaḥsab marra tubbuheřya nni igga di Israil.”
Munen marra iryazen n Israil di tendint-a, tuɣa munen ak-d wayawya am yijj n weryaz.
Uca sekkent tiqebbař n Israil iryazen ɣar marra taqbič n Binyamin, nnan: “Mana řefḍiḥet-a i ɣarwem imsaren?

Xenni řexxu, wcem aneɣ-dd iryazen nni, ayt i war isekkwin i iǧan di Jibɛa, ḥima ad ten nenneɣ uca ad ittwamḥa min iǧan d aɛeffan zi Israil.” Maca ayt n Binyamin war xsen ad sřen ɣar aytmatsen, ayt n Israil.
Usin-dd ayt n Binyamin zi tneddam nsen ɣar Jibɛa munen ḥima ad ffɣen ɣar umenɣi ak-d ayt n Israil.
Deg wass nni sedden nitni ayt n Binyamin zi tneddam, setta u-ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen inni izemmaren i ssif, břa imezdaɣ n Jibɛa i zzaysen ttwafarzen ɛad sebɛa-mya n yeryazen.
Jar marra řgens-a aqa din sebɛa-mya n yeryazen ttwafarzen i war ttwadarrben mliḥ s ufusi nsen afusi. Kuř ijj zzaysen izemmar ad iḥaka mliḥ aṭṭas s yeǧiy s ufus uzeřmaḍ, war xeṭṭin.
Uřa d iryazen n Israil ttwasedden. Nhřa ayt n Binyamin tuɣa aten di arebɛa-mya-ařef n yeryazen inni izemmaren x ssif. Marra nitni d iɛeskariyyen.
Kkaren ayt n Israil uca ffɣen ɣar Bayt-Il. Sseqsan AREBBI, nnan: “Man wen zzayneɣ i ɣa iffɣen d amzwaru ɣar umenɣi ak-d ayt n Binyamin?” Inna SIDI: “Amezwaru Yahuda.”
Kkaren ayt n Israil ɣar tuffut, wtin iqiḍan nsen ajemmaḍ i Jibɛa
Ffɣen yeryazen n Israil ɣar umenɣi ak-d Binyamin uca sedden yeryazen n Israil ixef nsen qibač nsen i umenɣi ɣar Jibɛa.
Xenni ffɣen-dd ayt n Binyamin zi Jibɛa uca ɣeḍřen zi Israil deg wass nni tnayen u-ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen.
Maca řgens, iryazen n Israil, ggin taryast, sedden ixef nsen ict n twařa nneɣnit i umenɣi ɣar mani tuɣa sedden ixef nsen deg wass amezwaru.
Uca ayt n Israil geɛɛden, run zzat i wudem n SIDI ař tameddit, sseqsan: “Ma ad ffɣeɣ ict n twařa nneɣnit ɣar umenɣi ak-d iḥenjiren n uma Binyamin?” SIDI yarra-dd: “Gaɛɛdem ḍidd i nnes i umenɣi!”
Deg wass wiss tnayen qarrben-dd ayt n Israil ɣar ayt n Binyamin,
uca iffeɣ Binyamin deg wass wiss tnayen zi Jibɛa maḥend ad kidsen immeřqa. Ɣeḍřen ɛawed tmenṭac-ařef n yeryazen ɣar temmurt, inni tuɣa marra zemmaren x ssif.

Xas uca ffɣen marra ayt Israil, řgens marra, uca iwḍen ɣar Bayt-Il, run. Qqimen dinni zzat i wudem n SIDI uca ẓummen deg wass nni ař tameddit uca qeddmen tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ d tɣarṣa n řehna zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Xenni sseqsan ayt n Israil SIDI, minzi di Bayt-Il tuɣa din Ttabut n Řɛahd n AREBBI deg wussan nni.

Deg wussan nni tuɣa ibedd Finaḥas, mmis n Aliɛazar, mmis n Harun, zzat i wudem nnes uca inna: “Ma ad neffeɣ ict n twařa nneɣnit ɣar umenɣi ak-d arrawen n uma Binyamin niɣ ad dayes nesmeḥ?” SIDI yarra-dd: “Ffɣem, maɣar tiwecca ad ten ggeɣ deg ufus nnec.”
Xas uca igga Israil řefxux ɣar marra iɣezdisen n Jibɛa.
Deg wass wiss třata geɛɛden ayt n Israil ḍidd i ayt n Binyamin. Sedden ixef nsen i umenɣi ak-d Jibɛa, am mammec tt ggin twařawin iɛdun.

Xenni ffɣen ayt n Binyamin i umsagar ak-d ayt n Israil u ttwassiggʷejen x tendint uca, am mammec twařawin iɛdun, bdan ad nɣin iryazen zi řgens x ibriden imeqqranen i zzaysen ittgeɛɛed ijj n webrid ɣar Bayt-Il u wenneɣni ɣar Jibɛa, nɣin ɛřaḥař třatin n yeryazen n Israil.
Xenni nnan ayt n Binyamin: “Aqa nitni ttwaɣeřben zzat i wudem nneɣ, am twařa tamezwarut.” Xenni nnan ayt n Israil: “Ejj aneɣ ad narweř, ad ten nessiggʷej x tendint ɣar ibriden imeqqranen.”

Xenni kkaren marra iryazen n Israil zeg wemcan nsen innuffaren u sedden ixef nsen i umenɣi ɣar Baɛl-Tamar. Di řweqt d ict ffɣen inni zi Israil i tuɣa ggin ijj n řfex zeg wemcan nsen innufaren zeg yefri n Jibɛa.
Ɛecra-ařaf n yeryazen ittwafarzen zi marra Israil usin-dd zeg urendad n Jibɛa u amenɣi idweř iwɛar. Maca ayt n Binyamin war ssinen, aqa ticti tḥart xasen.
SIDI iwta ayt n Binyamin zzat i wudem n Israil, ařami ayt n Israil nɣin deg wass nni xemsa u-ɛicrin-ařef u-mya n yeryazen, inni izemmaren marra x ssif.
Ẓrin ayt n Binyamin aqa nitni tuɣa ttwawten. Xenni wcin iryazen n Israil ttasiɛ i ayt n Binyamin, minzi nitni ttecřen x řfex nni tuɣa ggin ḍidd i Jibɛa.
Inni i tuɣa innuffaren, qeǧqen ad ḥejmen x Jibɛa. Ammu i ḥejmen inni i tuɣa deg wemcan innuffaren uca wtin marra tandint s řeqḍeɛ n ssif.
Iryazen n Israil tuɣa ggin awař ak-d yinni iggin řfex deg wemcan innuffaren, aqa nitni ad jjen aseynu ameqqran n ddexxan ad dd-igeɛɛed zi tendint,

uca xenni ad nnqeřben iryazen n Israil deg umenɣi. Binyamin tuɣa ibda ad ineɣ inni ittwassnuqqben zi Israil, ɛřaḥař třatin n yeryazen. Aqa nnan: “Nitni ttwawten nican zzat i wudem nneɣ am deg umenɣi amezwaru.”
DI tsaɛɛet nni ibda useynu ameqqran ad dd-igeɛɛed zi tendint am yijj n uqellij n ddexxan. Umi ixzar Binyamin ɣar ḍeffar, aqa tandint marra tgeɛɛed am ddexxan ɣar ujenna.
Xenni nnqeřben-dd iryazen n Israil uca iryazen n Binyamin iwta i-ten unexřiɛ, minzi nitni ẓrin aqa ticti taɛeffant tuɣa teřqef i-ten.
Nitni nnqeřben ɣar řexřa zzat i wudem n ayt n Israil. Amenɣi maca iḍfar i-ten, uca inni zi tneddam aqa ggin ict n tɣarṣt tameqqrant di řwesṭ nsen.
Nitni nnḍen i ayt n Binyamin, ḍfaren ten břa qeṭṭu, ɛefsen xasen ař amcan n arraḥet qibač n Jibɛa ɣar uɣezdis n ccarq manis dd-tneqqar tfuct.
Wḍan tmenṭac-ařef n yeryazen, marra nitni d iryazen imeḥḍen.
Xenni nnqeřben, arewřen ɣar řexřa, ɣar teṣḍart n Rimmun. U x webrid ameqqran qḍan zzaysen x xemsa-ařaf n yeryazen. Ḍfaren ten ař Jidɛum, wtin zzaysen ařfayen n yeryazen s řmewt.
Deg wass nni tuɣa marra inni iwḍan zi Binyamin di xemsa u-ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen nni zemmaren x ssif, marra nitni d iryazen imeḥḍen.
Setta-mya n yeryazen maca nnqeřben, arewřen ɣar řexřa, ɣar teṣḍart n Rimmun, uca nitni qqimen arebɛa n iyuren di teṣḍart n Rimmun.

Ɛeqben iryazen n Israil ɣar ayt n Binyamin uca wtin ten marra s řeqḍeɛ n ssif, zeg yeryazen n tendint ař řmař d marra min din ufin. Sennej i man aya ssarɣen marra tineddam i ufin deg webrid nsen s tmessi.

footnotes.text: war xsen ad sřen ɣar aytmatsen- s Tɛibranit ‘war xsen ad sřen ɣar tmijja n aytmatsen’.
